privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.controllerBody: {{org}} is the data controller for this application. Contact: {{email}}.
privacy.whatWeProcessLead: This app processes the following categories of personal data:

wp.admin: Admin credentials (username / password) provided via server environment variables.
wp.session: A short-lived session cookie (qm_admin) containing only an admin role marker — no personal identifiers.
wp.ip: IP addresses of failed login attempts, held in memory for up to 15 minutes for rate limiting.
wp.confluence: For admins who connect Confluence: the connected account's email or display name, Confluence site metadata, and access/refresh tokens (encrypted at rest).
wp.content: Whatever admins choose to write in scenarios, categories, tags, and images. Admins should avoid including personal data about identifiable individuals unless there is a lawful basis.

privacy.noEmployeeTracking: Employees who read scenarios are not required to sign in and no analytics, tracking cookies, or third-party trackers are used.

purpose.security: Rate-limit login attempts and protect the account from brute force.
purpose.confluence: Fetch and display Confluence page content that admins choose to link to a scenario.

privacy.legalBasisBody: Legitimate interest for administering procedures and securing access; consent from the admin who chooses to connect a Confluence account.

retention.session: Session cookie: 8 hours or until logout.
retention.content: Scenario and category content: until the admin deletes it. Deleting a scenario also removes its uploaded images.
retention.tokens: Confluence tokens: until the admin disconnects.

sub.supabase: Supabase — database and object storage. Data Processing Addendum available at supabase.com/legal/dpa.
sub.render: Render — application hosting. DPA at render.com/legal/dpa.
sub.atlassian: Atlassian — only when Confluence is connected. DPA at atlassian.com/legal/data-processing-addendum.

privacy.transfersBody: If Supabase or Render regions are outside the EEA, transfers are covered by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses in the respective DPAs. Prefer EU regions (Frankfurt / Ireland) where possible.
privacy.cookiesBody: Only one strictly-necessary cookie is used: qm_admin, an httpOnly session cookie set after admin login. No analytics or advertising cookies. Consent banner not required under ePrivacy for strictly-necessary cookies.

sec.encRest: Database encryption at rest via Supabase.
sec.encTokens: Confluence tokens encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage.
sec.access: Access control via timing-safe password check and signed session cookie.

privacy.rightsBody: Under GDPR you have the following rights over personal data about you:

rights.access: Access — request a copy of what we hold about you.
rights.rectify: Rectification — ask us to correct inaccurate data.
rights.erase: Erasure — ask us to delete data (subject to any legal retention duties).
rights.portability: Portability — request an export in machine-readable JSON.
rights.object: Object or restrict processing based on legitimate interest.
rights.complain: Complain to your national data protection authority.

privacy.contactBody: Contact {{email}} to exercise any of these rights. We will respond within one month.
privacy.breachBody: If we detect a personal data breach that is likely to result in risk to your rights and freedoms we will notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours and inform affected individuals without undue delay.

login.title: Admin Portal
login.magicSent: Check your inbox for a sign-in link.
login.resetSent: Check your inbox for a reset link.
login.registerSent: Check your inbox to confirm your address. An admin must invite your email before you can sign in.
login.registerNote: Registering doesn't grant admin access — an existing admin must add your email to the allowlist.
login.exchangeFailed: Could not start a session with the server.
login.supabaseUnavailable: Sign-in service unavailable. Contact an admin.
login.bootstrapWarn: Bootstrap sign-in is still enabled because no admins have been invited yet. Sign in below, invite yourself via Manage Admins, then remove ADMIN_PASSWORD from the server env.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.linkExpired: This reset link has expired or is invalid. Request a new one.
reset.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
reset.success: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.

admins.title: Manage Admins
admins.help: Add or remove people who can sign in as admin. New rows do not create a Supabase account — the invited person still has to register or sign in with the same email. Revoking keeps the row for audit and flips their access off.
admins.emptyList: No admins yet. Invite someone above.

categories.title: Manage Categories
categories.help: Categories appear in employee filters and the scenario form. Delete is blocked while scenarios use a category.
categories.label: Label
categories.empty: No categories yet. Add the first one above.

scenarioForm.title: Title
scenarioForm.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?

confluence.title: Confluence Integration
confluence.help: Link a Confluence page to a scenario and employees will see its content on the scenario page. The token is stored server-side, encrypted, and never leaves the API.
confluence.loadFailed: Could not load the Confluence page.
confluence.notConnectedHint: Connect a Confluence account below. Only admins can do this.
confluence.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Confluence? Linked pages will stop rendering until you reconnect.
confluence.cloudBlurb: Sign in with your own Atlassian account. You'll be redirected to Atlassian and back. The refresh token is encrypted before it's stored.
confluence.cloudNotConfigured: Cloud OAuth isn't configured on the server. Set CONFLUENCE_CLIENT_ID, CONFLUENCE_CLIENT_SECRET, and CONFLUENCE_REDIRECT_URI.
confluence.dcBlurb: Paste your Confluence base URL and a Personal Access Token (Profile → Personal Access Tokens in Confluence).
confluence.patStorageNote: The PAT is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). It is never returned to the browser.
confluence.dcNeedFields: Base URL and PAT are required.
confluence.pickerNoConnection: Connect Confluence from the sidebar to link a page.
